latestVersion.changelog:
SmartSaaS Skill v1.0.0 — initial release

- Adds support for creating and managing datasets and items via shell scripts (create-dataset.sh, add-to-dataset.sh) using execute_shell only.
- Requires explicit user instructions to add items; never auto-adds or infers items.
- Installation is via extraDirs in openclaw.json, not clawhub.
- Scripts use positional arguments only; do not use flags like --name or --dataset.
- API credentials (SMARTSAAS_BASE_URL, SMARTSAAS_API_KEY) are read from the environment; users are never prompted to provide keys in chat.
- All interactions are via provided scripts—never via curl or direct HTTP requests.
